verifications.claim: As of October 12, 2025, the Entry/Exit System (EES) registers non-EU visitors at borders with photos and fingerprints.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'As of October 12, 2025, U.S. citizens will need to go through the EU’s new Entry and Exit System ... Your fingerprints, facial image'; R4: 'As of October 2025, ... Entry/Exit System (EES) ... fingerprint scan, facial image capture'
verifications.reasoning: R2 directly matches the exact date, non-EU (U.S. citizens as example), and biometrics (fingerprints, facial image/photos); R4 confirms EES process with fingerprints and facial images for travelers.

verifications.claim: By late 2026, visitors from visa-exempt countries will need an ETIAS electronic travel authorization before traveling to 30 European countries.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'ETIAS. It plans to launch in late 2026'; R4: 'Beginning in October 2026, ... European Travel Information and Authorization System (ETIAS)'; R6: 'ETIAS travel authorisation is an entry requirement for visa-exempt nationals travelling to any of these 30 European countries'; R11: 'ETIAS ... for non-EU nationals from 59 visa-exempt countries travelling to 30 European countries (will start operations in the last quarter of 2026)'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm ETIAS requirement for visa-exempt visitors to 30 European countries launching late 2026 (last quarter/October), directly supporting the claim.
